Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an alternative driver's license and identicard for people who have two or more convictions involving driving while under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to drivers' licenses, indenticards, and liquorpurchases for people who have two or more convictions involving drivingwhile under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs; adding a newsection to chapter 46.20 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 66.44RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall develop an alternative driver's licenseand an alternative identicard that shall be issued to applicants fordrivers' licenses and identicards who have, in the ten years precedingtheir application, two or more convictions of any offense involvingdriving while under the influence of intoxicating liquor or any drug. (2) The alternative drivers' licenses and identicards developed bythe department under subsection (1) of this section must: (a) Be distinctly designed so that the alternative driver's licenseand identicard will not be confused with any other types of drivers'licenses and identicards issued by the department; and p. 1 HB 3346 (b) Include a clear statement that the alternative driver's licenseand identicard may not be used as acceptable forms of identificationfor the purchase of liquor, as defined in RCW 66.04.010. (3) The department may adopt rules to implement and administer thissection.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person issued an alternative driver's license or identicardunder section 1 of this act must show that license or identicard whenpurchasing or attempting to purchase any liquor. (2) It is unlawful for any person issued an alternative driver'slicense or identicard under section 1 of this act to purchase orattempt to purchase liquor. (3) It is unlawful for any person to sell, give, or otherwiseprovide liquor to any person issued an alternative driver's license oridenticard under section 1 of this act. (4) A violation of subsection (2) or (3) of this section is a grossmisdemeanor punishable as provided in chapter 9A.20 RCW.
